name: Lift.sum_twoWindows_le
summary: Each nonzero valuation is at most ⌊log_p H⌋ and comes from a multiple of p, of which there are at most 4m + 2; the windows have at most 4n + 2 elements.

steps.claim: Write the sum as Σ_y v_p(y) + |twoWindows(n, c)|·d; in the first sum only the y with v_p(y) ≠ 0 count, each at most ⌊log_p H⌋ (v_p(y) ≤ log_p|y| and |y| ≤ |c| + n ≤ H); these y are multiples p·k with k ∈ twoWindows(m, c div p) (shown next), so there are at most 4m + 2 of them; and |twoWindows(n, c)| ≤ 2(2n + 1).
A multiple y = p·k in [−n, n] ∪ [c − n, c + n] has k ∈ [−m, m] ∪ [c div p − m, c div p + m], since n ≤ pm and c = p·(c div p) + (c mod p) with 0 ≤ c mod p < p.
steps.lean:
simp; rintro m _ _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
